title: CWP/18793/2024 of SABDIL SINGH Vs STATE OF PUNJAB AND OTHERS
text:
219 IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH REKK Date of Decision: 07.11.2025 Sabdil Singh ...Petitioner Versus State of Punjab and Others ... Respondents CORAM:- HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE JAGMOHAN BANSAL Present:- Mr. M.S. Joshi, Advocate, Mr. Akash Patyal, Advocate and Mr. Guninder Singh, Advocate for the petitioner. Mr. Puru Jarewal, DAG, Punjab. ae eae JAGMOHAN BANSAL, J. (ORAL)

1. Learned counsel representing the petitioner submits that petitioner stands reinstated, however, his claim qua back wages in terms of judgment of this Court in Igbal Singh Vs. State of Punjab and Others, 2024 SCC OnLine P&H 5027 is still pending before Deputy Inspector General of Police (DIG), Bathinda Range, Bathinda.

2. Learned State counsel submits that Competent Authority would consider claim of petitioner in the light of aforecited judgment.

3. Let the needful be done within six months from today.

4. Disposed of.

5. Pending application(s), if any, shall also stand disposed of. (JAGMOHAN BANSAL) JUDGE 07.11.2025 Prince Chawla
